title: Payment Gateway Router (DIP and OCP)
instructions: Implement `CheckoutService` in `payments.py`. It receives its gateways and a country routing table from outside, validates them at construction, and routes `checkout(...)` to the right gateway by country. It must depend only on the `PaymentGateway` Protocol, so adding a gateway never requires editing it.

evidence.label: Routes each payment to the gateway for its country
Unrouted countries use the default gateway
Zero or negative amount raises ValueError without calling a gateway
Constructor raises ConfigurationError for unknown gateway names
A brand new gateway works with no change to CheckoutService
Later mutation of the caller's mappings has no effect
Charge is frozen and the service names no concrete gateway
